Read the opening free

Mara has spent months rebuilding a life small enough to feel safe. New apartment. New routines. No one close enough to know where she sleeps.

Then Elias Thorne is standing beside her bed.

He says someone else is coming. He says she has minutes. He knows which entrance to avoid, where the cameras point, and which window she forgets to lock.

The question is no longer whether he crossed a line. It is whether following him is safer than staying behind.

The line he should never have crossed

FAQ

Before you let him in.

No fine print. Just the files.
Is this a physical book?

No. These are digital editions. Each individual novel includes EPUB + Reader PDF.

Can I buy Book 2 or Book 3 separately?

Yes. Book 1, Book 2, and Book 3 are each available individually for $9.99.

What do I get with the Complete Trilogy?

All three novels in EPUB + Reader PDF, plus the 98-page AFTER THE LINE post-ending collection in EPUB + Reader PDF.

What is the Dark Edition?

The collector version: everything in the trilogy plus THE DARK ARCHIVE, THE PRIVATE FILES, and digital extras.

How do I receive my files?

After successful Stripe checkout, your purchase is verified and your protected digital files are made available for delivery.

Do I need a Kindle?

No. EPUB works with many e-reader apps, and the Reader PDF opens on phones, tablets, and computers.
